ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-gray to black primary mapping across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white focal spots and ring-shaped clusters stochastically distributed. A notable contiguous white patch is mapped at the distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center. The right side of the notch exhibits a sharp, vertical rise while the left side is partially obscured by a secondary fleshy protrusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-amplitude serration. The right lobe trailing edge contains multiple deep, jagged V-shaped indentations. The left lobe exhibits a more continuous but still coarse serrated topography with distinct valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the superior boundaries of both lobes, tapering toward sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely mapped circular and elliptical white high-contrast rings (diameters ranging from 5 to 25 pixels) consistent with barnacle scarring across the central and lower regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the interior portion of the left lobe and lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusion/deformity immediately to the left of the median notch. Deep jagged mechanical-type trauma marks visible along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique secondary triangular-shaped fleshy 'tag' or protrusion rising from the central median area.
